notes: WHAT THIS FILE IS. Texas plants the five research files missed: every Texas establishment in NAICS 31 to 33 that reported 300 or more people to OSHA on Form 300A for 2025 (or for 2024, when it has no 2025 row), is a plant within scope, and is not already a plant in one of the five files. Source: OSHA's establishment files (https://www.osha.gov/Establishment-Specific-Injury-and-Illness-Data), read from the copies on disk. The figure is the establishment's own 'annual average number of employees': that employer's people at that address, offices included, contractors not included. Web search was not available: nothing here was checked against a company page, and every plant's only source is the OSHA filing. COUNTS. 552 Texas rows with 300 or more people were read (duplicate filings removed); 207 matched a plant already in the five files by street address and 44 more were the same site under another address spelling or part of a complex listed as one plant; 104 were left out (listed below); 203 are plants to add: 179 placed here under 168 companies, 24 in unplaced. 20 of the placed plants rest on a 2024 filing because the establishment has none for 2025, which may mean it closed or simply had not filed: Cuisine Solutions San Antonio; Lonza Houston; Polytex Fibers Houston; Pactiv Evergreen Corsicana; Accredo Packaging Sugar Land; BuzzBallz Carrollton; Dart Container Dallas (Solo Cup); Danone Dallas; Load Trail Sumner; StarPak Houston; Elevate Windows and Doors Grand Prairie; Abimar Foods North; Borusan Pipe Baytown; Lasko Fort Worth; Ventura Foods Saginaw; Bell Plant 2 (Hurst); Superbag Houston; Dresser Utility Solutions Houston; Turbo Drill Industries Conroe; Dal-Tile Sunnyvale. COMPANY NAMES AND GROUPING. The OSHA company name is often a legal entity; plants are grouped under the name a job seeker knows, with the filed and legal names in alsoKnownAs. A company that is already in one of the five files keeps exactly the name it has there and its company fields are copied from that file (Abbott, Bell, Cardinal Health, Clayton Homes, Coca-Cola Southwest Beverages, Dairy Farmers of America, Dart Container, Dow, Georgia-Pacific, Halliburton, Mission Foods, NOV, Niagara Bottling, SLB, Schneider Electric, Tenaris, Tyson Foods). Groupings a reviewer should look at: the Haltom City plant that files as 'The Hillshire Brands Company' is under Tyson Foods; 'Solo Cup Operating' in Dallas is under Dart Container; the Minh plants at Deer Park and Pasadena are under Schwan's; Atrium (MW Manufacturers), Ply Gem and the Fairview Street metal buildings plant are under Cornerstone Building Brands; 'Glass and Glazing Systems' in Terrell is under Oldcastle BuildingEnvelope; 'Encore Medical' is under Enovis; 'Cantel Medical/Medivators' under STERIS; 'Cytec Engineered Materials', which files with Solvay as its company, is under Syensqo; 'Harbison-Fischer' under ChampionX with SLB as parent; 'Continental Autonomous Mobility' is its own company with parent Aumovio (the 2025 spin-off of Continental's automotive business); 'TCI - Texarkana' is Texarkana Aluminum; 'Republic National Industries of Texas' is Republic Elite; 'BMSC' (filed with company 'Elsa Panther') is taken to be Beauty Manufacturing Solutions Corp; 'Pactiv' is Pactiv Evergreen with parent Novolex; Polytex Fibers, StarPak and Superbag all file under 'Five Star Lower Holding' and are kept as three companies because each hires under its own name; U.S. Steel carries Nippon Steel as parent. These rest on the researcher's knowledge, not on a page read in this session. domain and description are given only for companies the researcher knows well: 49 companies have no domain. 'Cookie Baker', 'Vehicle Accessory Group', 'SPR Packaging', 'Uniwell Laboratories' and similar are entered exactly as filed, with nothing known beyond the filing. PRODUCTS are one plain line from the NAICS code the establishment filed and its name, sharpened only where the plant is well known; treat them as descriptions, not sourced facts. `naics` is the code as filed (a few are older 2017 codes). `opened` is null throughout. COORDINATES. From the project geocoder when its first answer was an address with the same house number in the right city or ZIP code (114 plants), otherwise from the US Census geocoder when it matched the house number (65 plants; Census points are interpolated along the street and can sit up to a block or so from the gate). A match was refused when the street's direction or type contradicted the filing (for example 'N Cockrell Hill Rd' answered with 'South Cockrell Hill Road'). Two were accepted by hand: Preferred Beef Group, Booker (filed as 910 E Industrial Rd; the map has East Industrial Avenue) and GRI Towers, Amarillo (NE 24th Street against the map's NE 24th Ave). Plants that would not resolve are in unplaced with their address, headcount and industry so they can be placed by hand; the four supplier plants inside the Toyota San Antonio campus are there because the building could not be located.
